description: Full-text search across all news articles from Wall Street Journal, New York Times, Bloomberg, Financial Times, CNBC, Reuters, Yahoo Finance. Powered by Meilisearch for fast, typo-tolerant search. Results can be filtered by source and sorted by relevance (default) or time. Native-language results are ranked higher when a language preference is set.

aiSummary.description: Return a concise AI-written summary instead of each result's full article body (fewer tokens, faster scanning); keep false when you need the complete text. Default: false.

lang.description: Language preference. Native-language results rank higher. Default: 'en'

limit.description: Number of results per page (1-20). Default: 15

marketOnly.description: Filter to market/finance-relevant results only, dropping general politics/lifestyle coverage. Default: false.

sources.description: Comma-separated source filter. Valid: wsj, nyt, bloomberg, ft, cnbc, reuters, yahoo. Omit for all sources.

name: search_news
